ruledOut: Treat the registry or fixture expectations as proof that runtime ANCHORS_VALID enforces required anchor IDs and order.
Treat marker-only edits as semantically neutral.
Treat successful re-application after partial migration as proof the migration is reversible.
edgeCase: The current native validator can pass marker sets whose IDs are present but whose marker ordering, nesting, or required template set violates the documented contract.
